heading: INT. COUNTY GENERAL - TRAUMA BAY ONE - NIGHT

units.text: INT. COUNTY GENERAL - TRAUMA BAY ONE - NIGHT
Empty beds, drawn curtains, every monitor lit and waiting.
A wall phone buzzes once.
Hallway lights flicker.
DR. FELIX AMADI, forties, snaps a gown over his scrubs.
DR. RENATA LINDQVIST, fifties, lines up chest tubes on a tray, in order, like silverware.
Bus rollover. Twenty-three patients, ETA four minutes.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Twenty-three. And we have six beds.
units.name: RENATA

units.text: She doesn't stop working.
He tears open a pack of gauze.
Everyone in this bay, listen. Triage at the door. Red tags left, yellow center, green to the cafeteria.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Green to the cafeteria. We should open a restaurant.
units.name: RENATA

units.text: Renata, I need you at the door.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: I need you to stop calling it "the door."
units.name: RENATA

units.text: It's a door!
units.name: FELIX

units.text: It's a funnel.
units.name: RENATA

units.text: The wall phone buzzes again, urgently.
They both reach for it, pull back, and speak at once.
Pick it up.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: ^Don't pick it up.
units.name: RENATA

units.text: The buzzing continues.
They look at the phone, then at each other, then at the empty beds.
Renata answers it with a sharp snap of her wrist.
Trauma One. Go.
units.name: RENATA

units.text: She listens.
Her jaw tightens.
She holds the receiver out to Felix without a word.
